item.tib: bka' yang zab gu ru rnam gsum gcig dril gyi kha tshar bzlog pa
item.coloph: ces pa'i drin can mi shig rdo rje yis (yi)/ bka' yi yang zab man ngag sku gsum bcud dril gyis (gyi)kha tshar bzlog (zlog) pa sngon chad mi 'dug kyang / rig 'dus gzhan la yod ltar brtsams pa'o/ gsang ba sngags la spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ gsang mtshan rdo rje bdud 'dul rtsal de nyid la/ grogs kyis rkyen bskul ca co rang 'dod tshig bris pas nyes 'gal ma tshogs bzod par gsol/ dge tshogs mchis tshe snyigs dus rkyen kag rnams/ dmigs med klong du bzlog bsgyur dza yan+tu// dge'o//
